name: kompas3d-mcp
description: MCP server that drives a licensed KOMPAS-3D v24 x64 via its COM API: parts, assemblies, drawings, export.
long_description: An MCP server that lets an AI agent drive a real, licensed KOMPAS-3D v24 (x64): parts, sketches, features, assemblies and mates, bill of materials, specifications, drawings, sheet metal, STEP/DXF/IGES export. Every mutating call reports a measured verification level, is journaled for safe retries and is confined to configured disk roots. Requires Windows x64, an installed and licensed KOMPAS-3D v24 x64 and the .NET 10 Runtime x64. Documentation is in Russian.

work_directory.title: Work folder
work_directory.description: Folder where the server may create, save and export models. It must not lie inside the read-only folder.

read_only_directory.title: Read-only models folder
read_only_directory.description: Optional folder with your own models: the server may open them but never writes there.
